title: Thai Sikh Run 2027 Review: What the 30th Edition Was Like
seo_title: Thai Sikh Run 2027 Review | Old Siam Plaza, Bangkok
meta_description: Thai Sikh Run review: 4,800 runners for the 30th edition on 1 February 2026 at Old Siam Plaza, Bangkok, over a 4 km fun run, 10 km and half marathon.
dek: The Thai Sikh Run marked its 30th edition in February 2026 with 4,800 runners in central Bangkok. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of the 31st.
verdict: The Thai Sikh Run is a long-running community race in the old city of Bangkok. Its 30th edition, on Sunday 1 February 2026, drew 4,800 runners, according to the Bangkok Post [1]. There were three races: a 4 km fun run, a 10 km mini-marathon and a 21.1 km half marathon, the championship race [1]. It started on Burapha Road by The Old Siam Plaza [2]. If you want a mid-sized Bangkok half marathon with three decades of history and a community feel, it is worth a look.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The 30th Thai Sikh Run was held on Sunday 1 February 2026, with 4,800 runners [1][2]. The Bangkok Post described the milestone edition as celebrating three decades of promoting fitness, heritage and community spirit in the capital [1].

Runners chose between a 4 km fun run, a 10 km mini-marathon and a 21.1 km half marathon, which was the championship race [1]. The race was based on Burapha Road at The Old Siam Plaza, in Bangkok's old city [2].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a half marathon in central Bangkok that is big enough to feel like an occasion but smaller than the city's major marathons. Thirty editions in, it is well established.

The available report covers turnout and categories rather than the course and aid stations, so check the route map and start times when the 31st edition's details are published. Expect an early start to beat the heat.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
